caption: The drawing consists of several objects and views rendered in fine black or gray lines on an off-white background. At the center is an elevation view of an ornamental stand or turned wooden object, characterized by a bulbous top, tapering central shaft, and three curved legs ending in scroll feet. Below this central object is a top-down plan view, showing the circular central body and projecting legs, with measured guiding lines and a scale in inches beneath it. To the immediate left and right of the main object are two bordered boxes. The left box, labeled "FRONT," contains a stylized depiction of a monument or structure with a pointed roof, a central medallion reading "US," mountains in the background, and stylized sunlight radiating from the top. The right box, labeled "SIDE," features a symmetrical decorative motif made from a central oval surrounded by petal or leaf shapes and dotted radiating lines. The name "HANS KORSCH" appears at the bottom left of the sheet. The overall composition is technical and decorative, emphasizing symmetry, clear linework, and precise proportions.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
